Overview

Bundaberg is a city in Queensland with a population of 73,747. Queensland’s rum and ginger beer capital with the Southern Great Barrier Reef and turtle nesting beaches. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
